execution.description: Ran the registry, campaign, construction-contract, admission-study and cold-plate focused suites before changing the Level-0 Launchpad integration.

expected: The focused baseline should identify any pre-existing failures separately from the new cooling integration, with canonical Linux acceptance deferred to the repository wrapper and CI.
observed: The usable Windows environment ran 183 tests: 169 passed, 1 skipped and 14 failed. Thirteen failures were known host/environment limitations (POSIX resource, UID/GID and file-mode behavior, or missing optional MCP/cryptography packages). One failure is a pre-existing stale closeout-file digest assertion on current main. The first three attempts also established that the default python launcher was absent or incomplete and that the carbon-ccm virtual environment was the usable diagnostic interpreter.
keep: Run the exact changed subsystem under canonical Linux before delivery.
Separate host diagnostic limitations and pre-existing failures from ticket regressions.
change: Use the repository's canonical wrapper or a dependency-complete virtual environment instead of assuming the Windows python launcher is usable.
